chk_projects_trashed_consistency.name: chk_projects_trashed_consistency
chk_projects_trashed_consistency.value: ("projects"."trashed" = false AND "projects"."trashed_at" IS NULL) OR ("projects"."trashed" = true AND "projects"."trashed_at" IS NOT NULL)

chk_assets_trashed_consistency.name: chk_assets_trashed_consistency
chk_assets_trashed_consistency.value: ("assets"."trashed" = false AND "assets"."trashed_at" IS NULL) OR ("assets"."trashed" = true AND "assets"."trashed_at" IS NOT NULL)

uq_jobs_active_export_per_project.name: uq_jobs_active_export_per_project
uq_jobs_active_export_per_project.where: "jobs"."kind" = 'export_render' AND "jobs"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."state" IN ('queued', 'running', 'cancelling')
